_meta.purpose: Du lieu gia lap nguoi dung de test tinh nang context-aware RAG (RBAC, cau tra loi phai khac nhau theo role/status/department/contract_type cua nguoi hoi).
_meta.data_label: SYNTHETIC - Khong phai nhan su that cua bat ky cong ty nao. Cong ty gia dinh V-NOVA.
_meta.usage_note: Ket hop voi eval/datasets/qa_eval_set.json: voi cung 1 cau hoi (vd 'Toi duoc thuong bao nhieu thang luong?'), agent phai tra ve cau tra loi khac nhau tuy theo persona goi kem.

personas.notes: Nhan vien moi, con trong thoi gian thu viec - chua du dieu kien WFH, chua duoc tham gia BHSTN, chua du 12 thang de huong day du phep nam.
Nhan vien chinh thuc, da qua thu viec, du dieu kien WFH 2 ngay/tuan va tham gia BHSTN.
Truong bo phan - co quyen phe duyet WFH/nghi phep cho nhan vien duoi quyen, xem duoc thong tin tong hop cua team nhung khong xem duoc luong cu the tung ca nhan ngoai team.
HR Admin - duoc xem toan bo chinh sach + du lieu tong hop toan cong ty, duoc quan ly ticket escalation, KHONG mac dinh duoc xem luong ca nhan tung nguoi neu khong thuoc nghiep vu dang xu ly.
Dang trong thoi gian bao truoc cham dut HDLD - khong con duoc ap dung WFH (theo nhom vi tri Van hanh), can thong tin ve quy trinh offboarding va thanh toan phep nam chua nghi het.
Tham nien cao (8 nam) - duoc cong them ngay phep nam theo tham nien (Dieu 114 BLLD), can test agent co tinh dung so ngay phep theo tham nien hay khong.
Dang mang thai - dung de test cau tra loi ve che do thai san, BHSTN quyen loi thai san, va nghi kham thai.
Thuc tap sinh/thu viec khoi san xuat - khong ap dung WFH, khong ap dung BHSTN cho toi khi ky HDLD chinh thuc.
